_doc: P6-6A Task 13: C-21 PSV AS 1210 火灾/管破裂/控制阀失效工况 vs Worley 真实算例 WS-CA-PR-025 首次对账 fixture。Calculation Sheet: AS 1210 §4.3.1/§4.3.2 + §4.4 + API 520 §3.4 combined relief sizing for Natural Gas liquefied vessel. ⚠️ MAJOR FORMULA FAMILY MISMATCH — Ruling 9 (2nd surface, C-17 was 1st surface). XLS-PR-025 uses TWO paths: API 520 path (G33=14.666 m², G34=390.72 kW, G35=6766 kg/hr) and AS 1210 path (G53=14.628 m², G54=649.81 kW, G55=11253 kg/hr) with C_API=323.66 vs C_AS1210=2.457. PCS service calc_as1210_relief_sizing hardcodes API 521 coefficient 43192 + ΔH_vap=2260 kJ/kg → PCS matches XLS API 520 path G34 within 经验 1% (0.0185% diff via direct q_fire_w) but NOT XLS AS 1210 path G54 (different coefficient C_AS1210=2.457 + different ΔH_vap≈208 kJ/kg implied). Direct overlap: input chain (vessel geometry → A_wetted via C-12 calc_wetted_area, XLS G33 EXACT match); set_p formula (TUBE_RUPTURE + CONTROL_VALVE_FAILURE algebraic EXACT); formula_ref sanity. OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 9: FIRE_CASE q_fire_w bit-for-bit with AS 1210 path G54 (Ruling 9); FIRE_CASE capacity bit-for-bit (Ruling 9); tube rupture XLS F78-F88 (AS 1797); flashing liquid relief F73-F93 (WL+WV simultaneous eqs); vapour/liquid split V83-Z93; LNG/non-LNG differentiation; pressure factor selection; critical flow pressure G80; MAWP derivation; fire env factor F; liquid level above grade F23.

mapping_defect.pcs_scope: PCS service calc_as1210_relief_sizing (SPEC §3.7.2 V1.4): 3 scenarios — TUBE_RUPTURE (set_p = as1210_pressure_factor·MAWP, capacity = tube_rupture_mass_kg_s); CONTROL_VALVE_FAILURE (set_p = CV factor·MAWP, AIR_FAIL=1.10 / SIGNAL_FAIL=1.20 / POWER_FAIL=1.15, capacity = tube_rupture_mass_kg_s × 0.5); FIRE_CASE (set_p = as1210_pressure_factor·MAWP, q_fire_w = 43192·F·A_wetted^0.82 [API 521 §3.4 SI strict conversion], capacity = q_fire_w / (ΔH_vap·1000) with ΔH_vap=2260 kJ/kg hardcoded). Takes As1210ReliefInput (frozen dataclass): mawp_kpa, tube_rupture_mass_kg_s, control_valve_failure_mode, fire_case_wetted_area_m2, as1210_pressure_factor, scenario, vessel_geometry (D7 接口冻结, calls C-12 calc_wetted_area when provided), environment_factor, imperial_units. Returns As1210ReliefResult: required_set_pressure_kpa, required_relief_capacity_kg_s, as_standard, pressure_factor, imperial_conversion, formula_ref (tube_rupture / control_valve_failure / fire_case / wetted_area_source 4 keys).

PCS service = AS 1210 §4.3.1/§4.3.2 + §4.4 fire case subset (TUBE_RUPTURE + CONTROL_VALVE_FAILURE + FIRE_CASE 3 scenarios). **MAJOR FORMULA FAMILY MISMATCH** (Ruling 9 — 2nd surface, C-17 natural gas saturation was 1st surface, same Ruling 9 ID applied to different formula family on different calc domain): XLS AS 1210 path uses C_AS1210=2.457 (G27) + implicit ΔH_vap≈208 kJ/kg (from Q_G54·3600/relief_load_G55 = 649.808×1000×3600/(11253.17×1000) = 207.88 kJ/kg); PCS service hardcodes API 521 coefficient 43192 (corresponds to XLS API 520 path C_API=323.66 — strict SI conversion) + ΔH_vap=2260 kJ/kg (typical light hydrocarbon/water simplification). **Direct overlap** (经验 1% 容差 per SPEC §5): input chain (vessel geometry → A_wetted via C-12 calc_wetted_area — XLS G33=14.666 m² EXACT match with H=1.867m); q_fire_w = 43192·F·A^0.82 matches XLS API 520 path G34=390.72 kW within 0.0185%; set_p formula (factor × MAWP) algebraic EXACT. **OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 9**: FIRE_CASE q_fire_w bit-for-bit with XLS AS 1210 path G54=649.81 kW (different C_AS1210=2.457 → magnitude diff 39%); FIRE_CASE capacity bit-for-bit with XLS G55/G57=11253 kg/hr (different ΔH_vap≈208 kJ/kg vs PCS 2260 kJ/kg → 17.9× diff); tube rupture XLS F78-F88 (AS 1797 specific derivation); flashing liquid relief F73-F93 (WL+WV simultaneous equations); vapour/liquid split V83-Z93; LNG/non-LNG differentiation; pressure factor selection; critical flow pressure G80; MAWP derivation; fire env factor F; liquid level above grade F23. 经验 1% 容差 per SPEC §5 applies to direct overlap fields only (input chain, q_fire_w vs XLS API 520 path G34, set_p algebraic); Ruling 9 OUT_OF_SCOPE for AS 1210 path G54/G55.

Direct overlap: input chain (C-12 calc_wetted_area → XLS G33 EXACT), set_p formula (factor × MAWP algebraic EXACT for TUBE_RUPTURE + CONTROL_VALVE_FAILURE), formula_ref sanity. OUT_OF_SCOPE per Ruling 9: FIRE_CASE q_fire_w vs XLS AS 1210 path G54 (C_AS1210=2.457 different formula basis); FIRE_CASE capacity vs XLS G55/G57 (ΔH_vap≈208 vs PCS 2260 kJ/kg); tube rupture F78-F88 (AS 1797); flashing liquid F73-F93 (WL+WV simultaneous eqs); vapour/liquid split V83-Z93; LNG/non-LNG; pressure factor selection; critical flow G80; MAWP derivation; fire env factor F; liquid level above grade F23.

service_inputs.mawp_kpa_derivation: XLS G79=761.3 kPa (relief pressure = MAWP × 1.10) → MAWP = 761.3/1.10 ≈ 692 kPa implied. For test clarity, use 1000 kPa (arbitrary) to make TUBE_RUPTURE set_p = 1.10×1000 = 1100 kPa (round number for algebraic check). MAWP derivation XLS row 42-49 OUT_OF_SCOPE per brief.
service_inputs.tube_rupture_mass_kg_s_derivation: XLS G84=27923.02420020396 kg/hr liquid relief rate (WL for flashing liquid) ÷ 3600 = 7.7564 kg/s.
